## Release v11.11 - [Feature Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-11-feature-release}

- **11.11.3, released 2026-10-22**
  - Mattermost v11.11.3 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Go runtime was updated from 1.26.7 to 1.26.10.
  - Pre-packaged Agents plugin version [v2.6.2](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/releases/tag/v2.6.2).
  - Added the ``EnforceLogPathRoot`` feature flag, disabled by default. When enabled, the server refuses to start, and a configuration save is rejected, if a log or audit file path resolves outside the logging root (``MM_LOG_PATH``, or the default logs directory). Validation now also covers ``LogSettings.FileLocation`` and ``ExperimentalAuditSettings.FileName``.
  - Mattermost v11.11.3 contains no database or functional changes.
- **11.11.2, released 2026-10-19**
  - Mattermost v11.11.2 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Playbooks plugin version [v2.11.4](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/releases/tag/v2.11.4).
  - Pre-packaged Jira plugin version [v4.8.2](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-jira/releases/tag/v4.8.2).
  - Pre-packaged GitLab plugin version [v1.13.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-gitlab/releases/tag/v1.13.1).
  - Updated custom emoji image processing to use the shared image decoder, so animated GIF sources are subject to the configured maximum image resolution and image decoder concurrency.
  - Updated file metadata preparation for post retrieval, channel bookmarks, and notification delivery.
  - Updated how EXIF metadata is read when determining image orientation.
  - Updated how database connection strings are reported in generated Support Packets and in server log output.
  - Fixed an issue where extracting content from ZIP archives could lead to excessive memory consumption.
  - Fixed an issue where invalidating cached sessions did not propagate to already-open websocket connections in some cases.
  - Fixed an issue where relative date separators between posts did not update when the local day changed while a channel stayed open, leaving a stale "Today" separator and creating a second "Today" separator for posts made after midnight.
  - Fixed the ``received_group`` WebSocket event so that it is delivered only to users who can read the group.
  - Fixed PDF content extraction so that arrays spanning multiple content streams are parsed correctly.
  - Mattermost v11.11.2 contains no database or functional changes.

## Release v11.10 - [Feature Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-10-feature-release}

- **11.10.4, released 2026-10-22**
  - Mattermost v11.10.4 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Go runtime was updated from 1.26.7 to 1.26.10.
  - Pre-packaged Agents plugin version [v2.5.4](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/releases/tag/v2.5.4).
  - Added the ``EnforceLogPathRoot`` feature flag, disabled by default. When enabled, the server refuses to start, and a configuration save is rejected, if a log or audit file path resolves outside the logging root (``MM_LOG_PATH``, or the default logs directory). Validation now also covers ``LogSettings.FileLocation`` and ``ExperimentalAuditSettings.FileName``.
  - Mattermost v11.10.4 contains no database or functional changes.
- **11.10.3, released 2026-10-19**
  - Mattermost v11.10.3 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Playbooks plugin version [v2.11.4](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-playbooks/releases/tag/v2.11.4).
  - Pre-packaged Boards plugin version [v9.3.2](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-boards/releases/tag/v9.3.2).
  - Pre-packaged GitLab plugin version [v1.13.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-gitlab/releases/tag/v1.13.1).
  - Pre-packaged Zoom plugin version [v1.13.1](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-zoom/releases/tag/v1.13.1).
  - Updated custom emoji image processing to use the shared image decoder, so animated GIF sources are subject to the configured maximum image resolution and image decoder concurrency.
  - Updated file metadata preparation for post retrieval, channel bookmarks, and notification delivery.
  - Updated how file metadata is served for drafts and post edit history.
  - Updated OAuth application management and authorization endpoint handling.
  - Updated how EXIF metadata is read when determining image orientation.
  - Updated how database connection strings are reported in generated Support Packets and in server log output.
  - Limited the input size accepted by the plain-text content extractor.
  - Added a Plugin API method for session-scoped file action policy checks.
  - Fixed an issue where extracting content from ZIP archives could lead to excessive memory consumption.
  - Fixed an issue where invalidating cached sessions did not propagate to already-open websocket connections in some cases.
  - Fixed an issue where relative date separators between posts did not update when the local day changed while a channel stayed open, leaving a stale "Today" separator and creating a second "Today" separator for posts made after midnight.
  - Fixed an issue with user profile update handling.
  - Fixed an issue with output formatting in ``mmctl``.
  - Fixed an issue with bulk import handling for existing accounts.
  - Fixed PDF content extraction so that arrays spanning multiple content streams are parsed correctly.
  - Mattermost v11.10.3 contains no database or functional changes.

## Release v11.7 - [Extended Support Release](https://docs.mattermost.com/product-overview/release-policy.html#release-types) \{#release-v11-7-extended-support-release}

<Attention>

**Breaking Changes**
 - Starting with v11.7.10, the updated `glibc-openssl-fips` bundle includes a new OpenSSL build that enforces the FIPS minimum key length of 112 bits for HMAC operations. The PostgreSQL driver (lib/pq) passes the database password as the HMAC key during SCRAM authentication, so a password shorter than 112 bits, or 14 ASCII characters, now causes a panic on connect rather than a graceful failure. Before upgrading, FIPS deployments should verify that the password in `SqlSettings.DataSource` is at least 14 characters and rotate it in PostgreSQL if it is shorter. Standard, non-FIPS builds are unaffected.

</Attention>

- **11.7.14, released 2026-10-22**
  - Mattermost v11.7.14 contains Low to Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Go runtime was updated from 1.26.7 to 1.26.10.
  - Pre-packaged Agents plugin version [v2.0.10](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/releases/tag/v2.0.10).
  - Pre-packaged Microsoft Calendar plugin version [v1.6.3](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-mscalendar/releases/tag/v1.6.3).
  - Added the ``EnforceLogPathRoot`` feature flag, disabled by default. When enabled, the server refuses to start, and a configuration save is rejected, if a log or audit file path resolves outside the logging root (``MM_LOG_PATH``, or the default logs directory). Validation now also covers ``LogSettings.FileLocation`` and ``ExperimentalAuditSettings.FileName``.
  - Fixed an issue where a draft sent from the Drafts panel could reappear after switching teams or reloading.
  - Fixed an issue where deleting a thread reply that mentioned multiple groups could leave a background process repeatedly querying the database until the server was restarted.
  - Mattermost v11.7.14 contains no database or functional changes.
- **11.7.13, released 2026-10-19**
  - Mattermost v11.7.13 contains Medium severity level security fixes. [Upgrading](https://docs.mattermost.com/upgrade/upgrading-mattermost-server.html) to this release is recommended. Details will be posted on our [security updates page](https://mattermost.com/security-updates/) 30 days after release as per the [Mattermost Responsible Disclosure Policy](https://mattermost.com/security-vulnerability-report/).
  - Pre-packaged Jira plugin version [v4.7.4](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-jira/releases/tag/v4.7.4).
  - Added the **Enable File Search** setting to **System Console > Site Configuration > File Sharing and Downloads**. When file search is disabled, the web app now hides the file search and channel files entry points instead of showing empty results.
  - Added the ``ElasticsearchSettings.EnableFileIndexing`` configuration setting to stop indexing file attachments in Elasticsearch and OpenSearch while still indexing posts, channels, and users.
  - Updated how database connection strings are reported in generated Support Packets and in server log output.
  - Fixed an issue where the Threads Unreads tab could show an empty list while reporting unread threads. If the issue persists after upgrading and a reverse proxy or CDN caches API responses, purge its cache once.
  - Fixed an issue where editing or deleting a post immediately after posting it could intermittently fail on servers configured with database read replicas.
  - Fixed an issue where the OpenSearch bulk indexing job could hang indefinitely when a connection to OpenSearch stalled.
  - Fixed a server panic that could occur when the initial OpenSearch node discovery failed.
  - Mattermost v11.7.13 contains no database or functional changes.
